import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int P1 = 998244353;
    static final int P2 = 1000000007;
    static final int half = 1000000;
    static final int[] pow10 = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000, 10000000, 100000000};

    static long n;
    static int ans, tot1;
    static long tot2;
    static long[] s = new long[10];
    static List<Integer>[] vec = new ArrayList[10];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            vec[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static int mod(long x, int P) {
        x %= P;
        if (x < 0) x += P;
        return (int) x;
    }

    static void init(int x, int v) {
        if (x > 6) return;
        vec[x].add(mod(tot1 - v, P1));
        s[x] += mod(tot1 - v, P1);
        tot1++;
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            init(x + 1, v * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static boolean check(long x) {
        return x * half + half - 1 <= n && x * half * 10 > n;
    }

    static void solve(int x, long v) {
        if (v > n) return;
        if (check(v)) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                int t = mod(tot2 + 1 - v * pow10[i], P1);
                int loc = lowerBound(vec[i], P1 - t);
                ans = mod(ans + s[i] + 1L * t * vec[i].size() - 1L * P1 * (vec[i].size() - loc), P2);
            }
            tot2 += tot1;
        } else {
            ans = mod(ans + mod(++tot2 - v, P1), P2);
            for (int i = (!x) ? 1 : 0; i < 10; i++) {
                solve(x + 1, v * 10 + i);
            }
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine().trim());
        init(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(vec[i]);
        }
        tot2 = -1;
        solve(0, 0);
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
